mandatory_correction: One consolidated correction for the selected film, shared by both treatments because the artwork and renderer are shared. (1) Replace the bill title with source-quoted or generic text containing no untraceable numeral. (2) Move the standards tag beside or below the highlighted review line so the condition stays readable from 37.6 s through s9. (3) Extend the desk and its face, or refit the answer-medium box, so the world covers the full frame width from 48.43 to 54.27 s. Optional notes: make the exam-table source of the speech marks identifiable in s1, keep the source cards' labels unoccluded, keep the how-well card's first letter clear of the thread, and lengthen the closing hold.

story_review.one_viewing_summary: Muted, a viewer sees spoken marks turn into an AI-drafted visit note with an empty check slot. A university plan, pilots and a vendor agreement arrive as cards, and the vendor's design threads the draft back to its source while a check hovers unplaced. A Texas bill lights 'diagnosis' and an AI review condition, a visit note meets the diagnosis frame with a question mark, and vendor and law threads converge on the still-empty slot beside a 'not stated' how-well field.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on an empty slot asking who verifies AI documentation and ends on the same empty slot with both the vendor's and the statute's threads pointing at it and the quality of the check marked not stated. That is a source-honest answer.
story_review.weakest_transition: s3 to s4 (15.87 s). The rollout row vanishes and a separate company release lands with no carried object or cause, so it reads as a list of facts. The reticle slot on screen keeps orientation but not causality.

strongest_frame: 29.8 to 30.8 s: a large close of the draft line threaded back to its lit source, with the outlined check hovering over the tick-framed empty slot.
weakest_frame: 40.2 to 41.4 s: the standards tag sits across the just-revealed 'review all AI-created records' line under a bill header carrying the untraceable 1188.
